title: The History of Major League Baseball
text:
Explore the history of Major League Baseball through the Lahman database. The home-run analysis traces how the rate of home runs per team-game has changed over time, highlighting shortened seasons whose totals can make them seem like outliers.
The Sluggers page ranks career home-run leaders and takes a closer look at Barry Bonds’s season-by-season record. Visit the analysis pages from the navbar to explore the data and the stories behind it.
